notes: Two exploratory runs (attempt-1: variable inspection and comparison of the three .dta files, which differ only in totalcont; attempt-2: window totals and switching-sample counts). Final model: logit (glm binomial) of aye (vote == 'Aye', all other responses 0) on totalcont, ACU score (ncu), tenure, poverty, bach, medincome, over65, agcom plus fixed-effect dummies (with a constant), on the units observed for both votes whose vote switched; robust HC0 sandwich SEs scaled by n/(n-1). District FE: district id; 93 switching districts after dropping one with missing tenure, N=186. Incumbent FE: rows with both==1 (same member at both votes), 53 switchers, N=106. Windows: SugarReplicate.dta = baseline (largest totals, 1 year before vote to end of calendar year), SugarReplicate_iter1.dta = calendar-year window, SugarReplicate_iter2.dta = 12 months up to the vote (mapping inferred from file order matching Table 3 row order).
